text:
Priya S: Quick sync — I'm refreshing the hello-starterkit quickstart to cover Azure Functions deploy + auth. PR #4620. Need a fast sanity-check for M1 Macs and Azure credential snippets.
Alex P: I'll run it on my M1 later today. Which parts are flaky?
Priya S: three spots: README references a sqlite native binary (breaks on M1), docker-compose lacks platform hint, and auth section assumes interactive `az login` only. Also env var names vary (API_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_KEY).
Dan M: I'll add cross-platform env examples (bash, PowerShell) and a tiny GH Actions secrets snippet. Keep it minimal.
Marie L: I can copy-edit after changes land. Tiny language note: prefer session-scoped env examples over persistent ones.
Alex P: tested briefly — docker-compose needs `platform: linux/amd64` for the provided image on M1. I'll add that and a short troubleshooting note.
Priya S: for Azure CI add a service principal example: `az ad sp create-for-rbac --name "redwood-deploy" --sdk-auth` and mention storing output in GH secret.
docs-bot: PR #4620 updated by priya — labels: docs, quickstart, azure
Priya S: plan: Alex adds platform line + M1 note; Dan adds PowerShell + GH Actions secret snippet; I'll normalize env to REDWOOD_API_KEY and land a short migration note. Target: merge tomorrow AM. Thanks! :sparkles:
